modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On September 11, 1903: The first race at the Milwaukee Mile in West Allis, Wisconsin is held. It is the oldest major speedway in the world.
On September 11, 1792: The Hope Diamond is stolen along with other French crown jewels when six men break into the house where they are stored.
September 11 is observed as Enkutatash falls on this day if it is not a leap year. Celebrated on the first day of Mäskäräm. (Ethiopia, Eritrea, Rastafari).
On September 11, 2024: Soyuz MS-26 is launched to the International Space Station, setting a record of 19 people in orbit at the same time.
September 11 is observed as Teachers' Day (Argentina).
